title: Battle of Alcântara (1580)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Alcântara (1580)", at revision 1380550607, opens: "The Battle of Alcântara took place on 25 August 1580, near the brook of Alcântara, in the vicinity of Lisbon, Portugal, and was a victory of the King of Habsburg Spain Philip II over the other pretender to the Portuguese throne, Dom António, Prior of Crato." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q741788, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1580 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
